caption: The drawing depicts a single glass jug positioned centrally on a blank, light beige background. The jug is rendered in shades of green, giving it a translucent appearance that mimics glass. It features a broad, rounded body that tapers at the top into a narrower, slightly flared neck with pronounced horizontal ribbing. The jug has a pronounced spout and a single, curved handle that connects from the top of the neck to the widest part of the body. The lower part of the jug is decorated with a wavy, raised pattern encircling the vessel, and it sits on a circular, slightly elevated base. There are no other objects or decorative elements in the composition, leaving the jug as the sole focus of the image. Handwritten text appears near the bottom left and bottom right of the image, just outside the jug drawing.
title: Pitcher
